description: Sort the lines of a block of text into alphabetical order. Blank lines are dropped. Uses natural en-GB ordering so numbers within lines sort sensibly. Can sort ascending (A to Z) or descending (Z to A), and can ignore case. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/alphabetical-order/

caseInsensitive.description: Ignore letter case when sorting (default false)

direction.description: 'asc' for A to Z (default), 'desc' for Z to A

text.description: The text to sort, one item per line

name: hopi_alphabetical_order

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)

title: Alphabetical order sorter
